record.question: Zeroth law of thermodynamics state that
options: Two thermodynamic system are always in thermal equilibrium with each other
If two systems are in thermal equilibrium then the third state will also be in thermal equilibrium
Two systems not in thermal equilibrium with a third system will also not in thermal equilibrium with each other
When two systems are in thermal equilibrium with a third system, they are in thermal equilibrium
